en: Black‑and‑white view of a large modernist office or institutional building with seven stories, flat roof and long rows of rectangular windows. In front there is a parking lot filled with 1950s European cars, a sidewalk, a simple post‑war style streetlamp and, to the right, a glazed elevated walkway connecting to another wing. A flag flies on the roof, but the design is not clearly legible.
